about: Patrols within reach_hours of its own march around a holding on the border, which widens what your realm can see, and tells you of each enemy army that comes within that reach (each at most once a day).
calls_back: an enemy army comes within its reach of the holding (each army at most once a day)

reach_hours: how far around the holding to patrol and watch, in hours of the lord's own march

when.if: army_near(at, pace * reach_hours) != none and not (told[army_near(at, pace * reach_hours)] > now)
when.poke: {me}'s screen near {at} sees an enemy army: {army_near(at, pace * reach_hours)}, strength {strength_of(army_near(at, pace * reach_hours))}, {distance(army_near(at, pace * reach_hours), at)} from {at}.
